product.name: Amy AI Medical Coder
product.description: An AI system that autonomously analyzes clinical documentation to assign accurate medical diagnosis and procedure codes compliant with current guidelines.

product.name: Marc AI Medical Biller
product.description: An AI tool that manages end-to-end medical billing processes, including claim submission, denial management, and consistent follow-ups.

product.name: Alice AI Auditor
product.description: An AI-powered auditing system that performs real-time data analysis to detect inaccuracies and provide ongoing education on coding standards.

product.name: Catherine AI Charge Entry
product.description: An AI solution that automates charge entry processes to improve accuracy, speed, and scalability in medical billing.

product.name: Deborah AI Denial Manager
product.description: An AI system that automates claim tracking, denial analysis, and appeal management with real-time error detection.
